title: User Story and Acceptance Criteria Standard
scope: Applies to Business Analysts during their first 30 days.
summary: Defines the required standard for user story and acceptance criteria standard.
details: User Story and Acceptance Criteria Standard must use an approved template, method or governance approach.
Outputs must be clear, reviewable and traceable to business objectives.
Assumptions, risks, dependencies, decisions and unresolved questions must remain visible.
Approvals and review comments must be retained as evidence.
employee_actions: Use the approved method or template.
escalation: Escalate unresolved ownership, approval or quality issues to the BA Practice Lead or Project Manager.
exceptions: Any exception requires documented approval from the policy owner.
keywords: user story and acceptance criteria standard
